texts.zh: 我们在[salvager_system.GetName]恒星系的进攻是一次反响斐然的成功。[FROM.GetName]被摧毁，所剩无几的幸存者逃向了深空。由于他们的设施被毁于一旦，他们那可怜巴巴的服务也成为了过去式。星系里再也没有这帮子人的踪影了。
texts.en: Our offensive in the [salvager_system.GetName] system was a resounding success. The [FROM.GetName] is destroyed, and the few remaining survivors have scattered to the void. With their facilities in ruin, their petty services are a thing of the past. The galaxy is well rid of them.

texts.zh: 我们收到报告，[salvager_system.GetName]恒星系的[FROM.GetName]太空城邦被毁。袭击者来去无影，一瞬间就把打捞者的设施变成了一堆废墟。所剩无几的幸存者四散逃离，看来，现在整个星系要学会习惯于没有他们提供服务的新生活了。
texts.en: We have received reports that the [FROM.GetName] Enclave in the [salvager_system.GetName] system has been destroyed. The aggressors made short work of the campaign, reducing the Salvagers' facilities to rubble. The few remaining survivors have scattered, and it appears that for the time being the galaxy will have to make do without their services.
